operating_notes.text: Cumulative orders received from Prestige Estates Projects Limited reached approximately ₹347.09 Cr following an additional order of ₹66.65 Cr.
FY26 consolidated revenue ₹542 Cr, up 72.4% YoY; Q4FY26 revenue ₹152.32 Cr, up 62.9% YoY.
FY26 cash from operations -₹152.58 Cr against -₹147.97 Cr in FY25; capex ₹9.54 Cr.
Modified Kanjurmarg land monetization structure with R Siddhatva Developers, appropriating ₹143 Cr advance against 75% land sale and balance 25% against increased area share.
Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 reports ₹100.40 Cr utilized during the quarter, bringing total utilization to ₹542.11 Cr.
FY26 recorded a 54% year-on-year revenue increase in the legacy business.

Nitco received ₹143 Cr for 75% of its Kanjurmarg, Mumbai land and expects about ₹250 Cr of revenue from 1,00,000 sq ft of commercial RERA carpet area plus 8,500 sq ft basement space due for the remaining 25%.

timeline.summary: Nitco Limited obtained shareholder approval via postal ballot for material related party transactions with Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited.
Nitco received an additional marble order worth ₹66.65 Cr from Prestige Estates Projects Limited, taking aggregate orders to ₹347.09 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹152.32 Cr (+62.9% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹7.73 Cr (against a loss of ₹0.05 Cr a year earlier).
Nitco approved modified terms for the Kanjurmarg land monetization with R Siddhatva Developers involving ₹143 Cr.
Nitco filed the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing ₹100.40 Cr utilized during the quarter and ₹542.11 Cr cumulatively.
Nitco reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹151.75 Cr, up 63% YoY, driven by strong growth in its marble and legacy tile businesses.
Vivek Prannath Talwar, as Nitco Limited’s promoter, declared no new share encumbrances by the promoter or promoter group for FY2025-26 on April 7, 2026.

Nitco completed registration of the conveyance deed for 75% of its Kanjurmarg land to R Siddhatva Developers (Runwal Construction step-down subsidiary), having received ₹143 Cr; the balance 25% awaits 1,00,000 sq ft of commercial space, from which it expects about ₹250 Cr of revenue.
